transformation: Derived from CLTS v1.4.1 data/sounds.tsv (GRAPHEME, NAME columns). Established empirically on 2026-08-13 by diffing this inventory against every tagged CLTS release: v1.4.1 matches 768 of 769 graphemes and 766 of 769 byte-identical NAME strings, against 689 and 680 respectively for v2.0.0 and later, so v1.4.1 is the source. Four rows diverge and are kept as they are: z̻ is not a CLTS v1.4.1 sound; ʈʂː is named 'long voiceless retroflex sibilant affricate consonant' here where v1.4.1 says 'voiced', which was an upstream inconsistency with its own ʈʂ entry and was corrected upstream in v2.0.0; ⁿgǃ is named with 'click' where v1.4.1 says 'nasal-click'; ç is named 'voiceless palatal fricative consonant' where v1.4.1 says 'voiceless palatal sibilant fricative consonant', since a palatal fricative is not a sibilant (the voiced ʝ is not marked sibilant in v1.4.1 either), corrected here in merkmal's distinctive 3.0.0 and descriptive 2.0.0. Feature sets are computed from the NAME tokens by tools/generate_c_data.py; no CLTS feature values, sound classes, or grapheme mappings are used.
citation: List, Johann-Mattis, Cormac Anderson, Tiago Tresoldi, Christoph Rzymski, Simon J. Greenhill, and Robert Forkel. 2019. Cross-Linguistic Transcription Systems (CLTS), version 1.4.1. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3515745 (author list as given in the description of the v1.4.1 release record, whose creator field lists only Robert Forkel; later releases list fewer authors, and the concept record 10.5281/zenodo.3515744 now lists five).
